Package org.odpi.openmetadata.adapters.connectors.datastore.parquetfile.properties

Class ParquetRowGroup

java.lang.Object
org.odpi.openmetadata.adapters.connectors.datastore.parquetfile.properties.ParquetRowGroup
public class ParquetRowGroup extends Object
ParquetRowGroup describes a row group in a Parquet file. A row group is a horizontal slice of the data that holds the values of every column for a set of rows.
